format: sources and cites are sourceCatalog keys; a step is [text, ...cites]; a guide (KEY, KEY) group cites the words before it; a conflict side is [cites, what they say]

IRH.label: IGN Wiki
IRH.page: How to Get a Rhino Tank

conflicts.title: Hours to platinum
sides: About 200 hours: 60-80 for the story, about 100 for the checklist and about 10 for clean-up.
Up to 300 hours or more, because the platinum means seeing and doing almost everything.
conflicts.call: The hours strip starts from PowerPyx's 200 h; slower players should plan nearer Push Square's figure.

conflicts.title: Missable count
sides: Potentially 1: Positive Mental Attitude, through the Chapter 1 meditation.
2 at risk: Positive Mental Attitude for good, and Strangers & Freaks through the timed Race Against Yago.
11 Chapter 1 missables, and none of them is a meditation or a trophy.
Its roadmap names no missable trophy at all.
conflicts.call: We flag both risks: the Ch.1 balcony meditation and Yago's Ch.3 race.

conflicts.title: Does the Ch.1 meditation count?
sides: It adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is unclear if the trophy needs it; the timing after Down to Earth may vary.
Lists it as the first of the 18 spots, inside Jason's house, and says it is unclear whether missing it locks you out.
Calls Positive Mental Attitude the only permanently missable trophy, because of this meditation.
conflicts.call: Do it in Chapter 1 either way; skipping it is the only way to lose the trophy.

conflicts.title: Is the Yago race missable?
sides: A timed Chapter 3 hourglass mission: leaving it can lock you out of Yago's missions and put Strangers & Freaks at risk.
One of Yago's races is timed; save and run it the moment the hourglass appears.
Hourglass quests fail after a while but are not relevant for trophies, and Strangers & Freaks are still there after the story.
conflicts.call: Run it at once from a fresh save: it costs a few minutes and removes the risk.

conflicts.title: Chapter trophy pops
sides: The official texts read Complete Chapter 1, 2 and 3.
Paradise Lost pops after What's in the Bag? (Ch.2), T**s Ass Drug Money after Welcome to Vice City (Ch.3), and Vice City, Baby! after Ocean Beach and Another Life (Ch.4).
conflicts.call: Make each chapter-end save once the trophy has popped.

conflicts.title: 100% menu path
conflicts.call: Steps quote Push Square's path; if the tab is not there, look under Stats.

conflicts.title: Optional missions for 100%
sides: Any 100 Optional Missions count toward the checklist.
Finishing all the Optional Missions is a requirement.
conflicts.call: The counter targets 100; play extras as they appear, since many optional missions disappear after a while (PPX).

conflicts.title: Grade split
sides: The list splits 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze.
Marks Maximum Withdrawal bronze, which adds up to 1/2/5/47.
conflicts.call: We keep PowerPyx's 1/2/6/46 split, which main.ts checks, with Maximum Withdrawal as the sixth silver.

conflicts.title: Race count
conflicts.call: Either way the trophy needs 20 different wins.

conflicts.title: Kenton's wrecks and markers
sides: 7 shipwrecks (7 sets), shown as purple chest icons.
41 treasures across 7 dive sites; a small yellow chest marks each item.
5 Kenton treasure sets, one per shipwreck.
conflicts.call: The trophy pops on Maritime Disputes either way (PSQ).

conflicts.title: Arcade game spots
sides: The first three games are on the home TV from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines.
All four play at home after Tap to Reveal; Bang For Your Buck and Street Trash 3 also run in arcades.

conflicts.title: Master of None race slot
sides: One slot covers a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race.
You will also have to try a Top Fun drone race for Master of None.
conflicts.call: Do one drone race as well; it is cheap insurance.

conflicts.title: Strand mission names
sides: Kirk: Skunk Apeology 101, Tree Effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics; Race Against Yago is third in Yago's list.
Kirk: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove; Yago's list has no Race Against Yago; Pilot Pete has five Chapter 4 missions.
Yago's missions start with Race Against Yago in Chapter 3.
conflicts.call: Names differ while guides catch up; follow the stranger icons and the trophy counter.

conflicts.title: Scooter Bros registration
sides: At a Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop, at any time.
At Moses' garage first; from Chapter 3 at any Pay 'n' Spray.
conflicts.call: Use Moses early and a Pay 'n' Spray later.

conflicts.title: WAiNK total
sides: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher Tags, with no billboards listed.
conflicts.call: Only 100 are needed, so the exact total does not matter.

conflicts.title: Thrillbillies: Billy or story?
sides: Lists Thrillbillies as a Chapter 2 main mission.
conflicts.call: Play it either way; Hometown Heroes is the one that pops.

conflicts.title: Rhino tank spot
sides: In the south of the base, with a stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
All over the base; the South stunt jump lands you just west of them.
conflicts.call: Take the south jump in and look around.

conflicts.title: Top Fun entry fees
sides: Some sites charge an entry fee.
Every race starts from a van where you pay a flat fee.
conflicts.call: Bring some cash to each site.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum asks for the other 54 trophies (PPX, I100), all earned offline in single-player with no difficulty setting to worry about (PPX). PowerPyx rates the list 4/10 at about 200 hours (PPX); Push Square budgets up to 300 hours or more (PSQ). PowerPyx gives the split as 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze (PPX), and TrueTrophies shows 28 of the 55 as hidden (TT).
steps: Play the five-chapter story first: progress made there already counts toward 100%.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter, 10 of the 15 slots.
There is no mission replay, so those saves are the only way back.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter closes.
After the credits, work the checklist under Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion.
Finish with Strangers & Freaks and the leftovers.
Never enter a cheat on this save: cheats block trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Slot 1 of PowerPyx's 10-save plan: Chapter 1 start. The balcony meditation comes later in this chapter.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1 (PPX, IGF). IGN's walkthrough has Jason and Cal pulling dropped cocaine bricks out of the Leonida Keys from a Lure Predator boat (IGF). It unlocks automatically with the story (PPX, PSQ); the real job here is starting the chapter-save routine (PPX).
steps: Gone Fishing is Chapter 1's first main mission; it starts on its own.
Drive the Lure Predator to the dropped package; pause and open the Map to see where it is.
Finish the mission; the trophy unlocks with it.
Make manual save slot 1 now: your Chapter 1 start.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Slot 2: Chapter 1 end. After this point the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is gone for good.
trophies.guide: The text says Complete Chapter 1, but PowerPyx reports it popping after the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag? (PPX). IGN lists 11 Chapter 1 missables, such as Macizo Cigars and Get Shirley's Rum (IC1); none of that side content is tied to a trophy (PPX, GC). The one that matters is the balcony meditation, which has to be done before you leave (PPX, BEE, GC).
steps: Before the last Chapter 1 mission, confirm the balcony meditation shows in Progress.
Optional: clear IGN's Chapter 1 missables such as Get Shirley's Rum; none affect trophies.
Play into Chapter 2 and finish What's in the Bag?.
Nothing extra is needed: it unlocks as part of the story.
Save to slot 2 (Chapter 1 end) and never overwrite it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Slot 4: Chapter 2 end. Keep it before the move to Vice City.
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 story trophy; PowerPyx reports it after Welcome to Vice City, the first Chapter 3 mission (PPX). It is an automatic story unlock (PPX, PSQ). Guides print the official name with its asterisks (PPX, PSQ).
steps: Coffee Break in Chapter 2 opens partner free roam: Hot Together, Retail Therapy and Personal Best start here.
Finish Chapter 2, then play Welcome to Vice City.
It unlocks as part of the story.
Save to slot 4: Chapter 2 end, before the move to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Slot 6: Chapter 3 end, right before Chapter 4 begins.
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 story trophy; PowerPyx has it after Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two Chapter 4 missions (PPX). It is an automatic story unlock (PPX, PSQ). Chapter 3 is also where Andy, Randy, Tyrone, the Key Cloner and the Snap Gun arrive (PPX).
steps: Chapter 3 opens Andy (Lucia only), Randy's Wish List and Tyrone (Jason only); accept each strand.
Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS gives the Key Cloner; Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives the Snap Gun.
Play Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Slot 8: Chapter 4 end, after Starting From Zero.
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 story trophy, tied by PowerPyx to the last Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero (PPX). It is an automatic story unlock (PPX, PSQ). Chapter 4's optional That's Where The Money Is… opens the bank vaults, so play it when it appears (PPX, GC).
steps: Play That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) when it appears; it starts vault robberies.
Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Child's Play all fall in this chapter.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Slot 10: the pre-finale save. No mission replay means this is the only way back.
trophies.guide: Gold for finishing the final story mission (PSQ, EXO). Free roam carries on afterwards but there is no mission replay (PPX, GC, OL), and the 100% Completion checklist only becomes visible after the story (PPX, PSQ, I100, GC).
steps: Keep slot 10 as a pre-finale save; it is your only way back into the story.
Play the final mission through the credits; the official text asks nothing more.
You can keep exploring Leonida after the credits.
Open Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion: the checklist is now live.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Slot 3: Chapter 2 start. Breakfast Run and Coffee Break follow in this chapter.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 (PPX, IBR). IGN's walkthrough starts at the motel where Jason is recovering and points you to Hank's Waffles in north Port Gellhorn (IBR). It unlocks automatically with the story (PSQ, PPX, GC).
steps: Save to slot 3 at the start of Chapter 2.
Breakfast Run (Check on Jason) starts back at the motel.
IGN advises a save before the drive to Hank's Waffles.
Finish the mission; it unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Slot 5: Chapter 3 start, before The Cartel Heist.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 (PPX). It unlocks automatically with the story (PSQ, PPX, GC). Credit Check earlier in the chapter also unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need for Dime on the Dollar (PPX).
steps: Save to slot 5 at the start of Chapter 3.
Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering.
Complete The Cartel Heist; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Slot 7: Chapter 4 start, before Child's Play.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4 (PPX). It unlocks automatically with the story (PSQ, PPX, GC).
steps: Save to slot 7 at the start of Chapter 4.
Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission.
Complete it; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission (PPX). It unlocks automatically with the story (PSQ, PPX, GC).
steps: Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission; keep your slot 7 save from the chapter start.
Headliners sits in Chapter 4 with Child's Play and VCIA Takedown.
Complete Headliners; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 (PPX). It unlocks automatically with the story (PSQ, PPX, GC). Catch Me If You Can is a separate trophy: it needs a passenger plane stolen from a VCIA boarding bridge (PPX).
steps: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 main mission.
Catch Me If You Can is separate: it needs a plane from a boarding bridge.
Complete VCIA Takedown; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Slot 9: Chapter 5 start, before Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 (PPX). It unlocks automatically with the story (PSQ, PPX, GC).
steps: Save to slot 9 at the start of Chapter 5.
Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main mission.
Complete it; the official text asks nothing more.
It unlocks as part of the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (PPX, I100); it sits near 60% true completion (PPX), and all of it can be finished in free roam (PPX, GC). The bars run from 42 range golds to 300 stunts (I100, PPX); 15 of 18 card sets is enough (PSQ, I100).
steps: Finish the story; earlier progress already counts.
Complete any 100 Optional Missions as they appear.
Study 100 of 255 animals with the binoculars.
Track it in Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of 397 stunts across four types: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps (PPX, PSQ, IST). The extra challenge on each jump is optional (PSQ, PPX), and the 100% checklist wants 300 anyway (I100, PPX).
steps: Mix any of the four types; PowerPyx rates Under the Bridges the quickest.
Track them under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts.
Find spots on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of 9 activity types once (PSQ, PPX): fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball hoops, a video game, a race or drone race, and a stunt (PPX). IGN says a Top Fun drone race is needed for this trophy (ITF, I100).
steps: Open Touch Pad > Progress > Activities to see which types are done.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell) to find the rest.
Try one Top Fun drone race; IGN lists it for this trophy.
Most of the nine happen naturally during the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (PSQ, PPX, I100). The ranges sit at two hubs, Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero (IRG, PSQ), 12 ranges in all (IRG, PPX).
steps: Rodgers Ranch charges a $5 waiver; only 3 of its 6 ranges open on the first visit.
Start on the free Market Range, then unlock the rest.
Most challenges have three tiers, each needing gold; check locked ones on the map.
Range sessions also raise Focus, which makes Gunslinger easier.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (PSQ, PPX). PowerPyx counts 42 drone races across those 14 sites (PPX), and 100% needs all 42 (ITF, PPX).
steps: Find sites under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
Some sites charge an entry fee.
Win at least one race at each of the 14 locations.
Clear all 42 for the 100% checklist while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; winning the same one twice counts once (PSQ). IGN's race guide covers 39 races with buy-ins and rewards (IRC), and PowerPyx links 40 unique race locations (PPX).
steps: Track races under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.
Hire a car at the venue, or raise your own car's Rating at a Mod Shop.
Check IGN's list for buy-in prices before travelling.
Pick 20 of the roughly 40 venues PowerPyx maps.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1's Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a purple fishing marker (PPX). Push Square says he wants a Parrotfish over 2 kg, caught from a boat with a rod (PSQ). IGN's fishing guide maps hotspots for all 35 species (IFI).
steps: Finish Feng Shui (Meet Cal) in Chapter 1, then wait for his text.
Head to the purple fishing icon.
Take or hijack a boat with a fishing rod nearby.
Use IGN's hotspot maps if the bites are slow.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: There are four games, Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck (PPX, IGA); finish every level of any one of them (PPX). PowerPyx puts the first three on the home TV from Chapter 1 (PPX), while IGN says all four play at home and two also run in arcades (IGA).
steps: Use the home TV from Chapter 1: at least three games are there.
Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the map.
Reach the end of one game; its side challenges are optional.
IGN's game pages explain what each one asks of you.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia-only (PPX, OL, GC): a call during Chapter 3, then a Belville address (PPX, OL). It pops after all of Andy's missions (PSQ, PPX).
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and take Andy's call.
Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), then Pay the Cellerica Fee.
Puff Puff Pass ends the strand.
Finishing every Andy mission is the trigger.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's dive strand opens after Island Dreams in Chapter 1 and covers 7 shipwrecks (PPX, IKE). IGN counts 41 treasures across those 7 dive sites (IKE); Push Square names Maritime Disputes as the final mission (PSQ).
steps: After Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), wait for his call; his KR icon is in Key Lento.
Dive the purple chest markers; use the metal detector on the sea floor.
Track the 41 finds in Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
He pauses after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again in Chapter 2-3.
Finish Maritime Disputes to unlock it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand appears after Chapter 2's Coffee Break at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County (PPX, OL); the last mission is Hometown Heroes (PSQ, PPX, OL).
steps: After Coffee Break, head to Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Thrillbillies, then Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab.
Hometown Heroes is the final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Race Against Yago arrives in Chapter 3 as a timed hourglass mission. Save and run it the moment it appears: letting it lapse can shut Yago's strand and put this trophy at risk.
trophies.guide: The trophy asks for 8 stranger strands (EXO, TT, PPX, PSQ, OL). Many side strands do not count, including Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie (PPX, OL). Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count so far (PPX, OL); the other four are still unconfirmed (OL). Yago's Chapter 3 race is timed (GC, OL), so treat it as the second missable risk (GC). The trophy list shows your strand count (PPX).
steps: Kirk: Skunk Apeology 101, Tree Effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics.
Kyle: McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?.
Ch.3: save, then run Yago's hourglass race the moment it shows.
Yago: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother.
Pilot Pete (Jason only): Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries.
Watch the 8-strand counter on the PS5 trophy for the rest.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens with Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 and asks for 16 sports cars (PPX, OL). It pops after all of Randy's missions (PSQ).
steps: The Zorrusso is delivered during Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Scan high-end cars with WAiNK to see if they are on his list.
Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels are good hunting spots.
Deliver every car on the list to finish his missions.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone appears after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 (PPX, OL), and only for Jason (PPX, OL, GC). It pops after all of Tyrone's missions (PSQ, PPX).
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty, play as Jason.
Destroy the purple-marked Kitty Litter labs in Vice City.
Then play Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs).
Finishing every Tyrone mission is the trigger.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: After Down to Earth, accept Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, with no mission replay.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditations (PPX, BEE, PSQ, GC, I100) at 10 locations (PPX); a spot done as both Jason and Lucia counts twice (PPX, BEE). The first exists only in Chapter 1, at Jason's house after Down to Earth (BEE, PPX, GC); it is unclear if the trophy needs it, so do it (PPX, BEE). A spot counts once the zen animation ends (PSQ).
steps: Finish Down to Earth (Meet Brian), after Buck Me.
Next morning, follow Lucia to the balcony; pick Accept.
Let the zen animation finish before moving.
Do the rest; the 18th, Mount Kalaga, shows last.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret texts Jason after Chapter 2's Coffee Break; his first quest, Veteran Hunted, is in Lummox County (PPX, OL). PowerPyx has not yet confirmed which animal triggers it (PPX), but all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway (PPX, I100). TrueTrophies lists it as a hidden trophy (TT).
steps: Play Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) as Jason.
Collect his Killtelligence SM-69 rifle from any Ammu-Nation locker.
Track hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck.
Clear all 15 decks; the trophy comes along the way.
Hidden on the PS5 list, so Spoiler Mode shields it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 card sets (PSQ, PPX). IGN counts 481 cards across those sets, with a page per set (ICA).
steps: Pick three small sets from IGN's set pages.
Track sets in Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Cards sold at a Pawn Shop still count.
100% needs 15 sets, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots (PSQ, PPX); IGN counts 108 to choose from (IWA). The main types are 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher Tags (PSQ, PPX, IWA), and IGN also counts 4 Peewees billboards (IWA).
steps: When the WAiNK prompt shows, press D-pad Up and hold R1 to scan.
Mix Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and No Flusher Tags.
Check Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
Any 100 count, and the 100% checklist also asks for 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: 80 challenges exist; 50 unlock this and 70 are needed for 100% (PSQ, PPX). PowerPyx suggests leaving it late, since many clear on their own (PPX); IGN lists every challenge (ICH).
steps: View them under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges.
Leave it for late; many clear while you do other trophies.
Pick quick ones from IGN's list, such as Speed Kills: 3 kills in 30 seconds.
Push on to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once Chapter 2's Coffee Break lets Jason and Lucia free-roam together (PPX). Reach 4 stars with your partner and leave the red heat zone (PPX); IGN's wanted guide covers clearing heat (IWT).
steps: Call your partner, then cause trouble until you reach 4 stars.
Escape on a fast motorbike, or via the train tunnel north of Ambrosia.
It counts once you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
Use IGN's wanted guide for ways to clear heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping the flashing wanted level; possible after Coffee Break (PPX). The official text says back-to-back with your partner, so stay together (EXO, TT, PSQ, PPX).
steps: Bring armor, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline.
Use the three Vice City jewelry stores, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Keep the flashing wanted level; do not let it drop to heat.
It pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles: scanning with WAiNK is enough, no driving needed (PPX, PSQ, I100). Getting in one also counts (PSQ), and IGN counts 277 base vehicles (IVE, PPX).
steps: Hold D-pad Up for WAiNK, then hold R1 to scan passing traffic.
Getting into a vehicle also discovers it.
200 of the 277 are needed for 100%, so this comes early.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus window (PPX, EXO, TT, PSQ). It reportedly fails on police and soldiers, so use gang members (PPX). TrueTrophies shows it as a visible trophy (TT).
steps: Buff Focus with food, drinks or a shower; Adrenaline extends it.
Line up 5 gang members at a Gang Operation.
Wear body armor and use an accurate rifle such as the Duke 556.
Raise Focus to level 4 through ranges, golf, pool and fishing.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger plane docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly 1 km away (PPX).
steps: Planes on the apron do not count; use one at a boarding bridge.
Terminal E3/E4 is easiest: stairs by the bridge lead into the plane.
Go up to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off.
Fly 1 km from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhino tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west (PPX, IRH), in Mariana County (PPX). IGN's route uses the base's south stunt jump (IRH).
steps: The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station.
The Mile Zero Air Station South stunt jump lands you just west of them.
Bring Adrenaline or body armor; being spotted brings a wanted level.
Get in and fire at enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Needs the Snap Gun from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (PPX, OL). Get in quietly, open the safe and kill the cameras and alarm (PPX).
steps: Pick the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it.
Find the note with the safe code and open the safe.
Destroy the footage and disable the alarm in the back room.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape (PPX); all 8 are needed for 100% (PPX, GC, I100). Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… teaches the job (PPX, GC).
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security van tips, after two Payday Loans jobs.
Tail the van, rob the open vault, and hand a bag to your partner.
Lose 4 stars on a fast bike, then switch vehicles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: A large bank vault job counts as an armored truck robbery (PPX). You can also do it earlier by sticky-bombing a truck's back door (PPX).
steps: Easiest: a vault job from That's Where The Money Is….
Earlier: block a truck and sticky-bomb its back door.
Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
Escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map; a plane is fastest (PPX). The PS5 trophy tracks 52 areas (EXO).
steps: Take a plane and fly over every black fog patch.
Watch the 52-area counter on the PS5 trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: 9 gangs run 39 Illegal Operations, and one per gang unlocks this (PPX); 100% needs all 39 (PPX, I100). IGN lists each operation by chapter (IIO).
steps: Start with Chapter 1's Fishing Shacks; IGN lists the rest by chapter.
Yellow map icons mark operations near you.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy and drink an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach (PPX).
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window; only that car counts (PPX).
steps: Get the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3.
Find the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom.
Clone it and drive straight through the window.
It pops a little way down the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, Kolt & Associates' operation in Port Gellhorn (IBO, PPX, GC). Open the safe with sticky bombs or its code (PPX, IBO).
steps: Kingpin Bowling is south of the Pawn & Gun Ammu-Nation in Port Gellhorn.
Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first.
Take the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 and the safe.
It pops once you escape the police.
Missed one? The operation comes back later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max Strength on Jason and Lucia at once; possible after Coffee Break (PPX).
steps: Bring your partner: they train while you train.
Check Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.
After the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your criminal profile, and the trophy list shows the count (PPX). Most come naturally (PPX).
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile HUD notifications.
Watch the 500 counter on the PS5 trophy.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile; it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: TrueAchievements players report the fix: rob the Payday Loans store Lucia hit in the Prologue a second time (TA, PPX). PowerPyx adds the conditions: come back as Lucia alone, after Chapter 3's Credit Check, and escape on foot (PPX). That fits the official hint, Second time's the charm (EXO, PPX).
steps: Finish the Prologue; note the Payday Loans store Lucia robs.
The store is Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City.
Return after Credit Check (Ch.3), as Lucia alone.
Rob it a second time and get away on foot.
The unlock is slightly delayed, so keep running.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UFO event on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 AM and solo (PPX).
steps: Go alone after 2 AM; look for a blinking car at the roadside.
No car? Drive away and come back.
Follow the path into the woods toward the blue light.
Help the woman back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Kick 10 pedestrians in 60 seconds from a motorbike or bicycle (PPX).
steps: Use crowded areas such as Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences, counted across all robberies (PPX).
steps: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Sell to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays most.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (PSQ, PPX, EXO, TT). Guns, car mods and tattoos cost most (PPX).
steps: Find shops via Touch Pad > Style.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the quickest way to spend.
Spending adds up across every shop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate app (PSQ, PPX). They go on sale after Daily Driver in Chapter 2 (PPX).
steps: Finish Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) in Chapter 2.
Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Prices run from $4,000 (Mitchel Auto Center) to $40,000 (Atlantic Court).
The 4 story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to Scooter Bros at a Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop (PSQ). The app arrives after Moses in Chapter 2 (PPX).
steps: Finish Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) in Chapter 2.
Buy garages first; each adds parking spots.
Register at a Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop.
Cheap cars and bikes keep the fees low.
